projection.statement: Assess technical soundness and meaningful knowledge advancement while avoiding automatic rejection for small repairable issues or absence of state-of-the-art performance.

sections.extracted_fact: ECCV asks reviewers to assess technical soundness and contribution while balancing novelty, impact and performance and not rejecting for easily corrected minor flaws.

verbatim_excerpts.text: technically sound and make a contribution to the field

verbatim_excerpts.source_locator: Reviewing In a Nutshell > knowledge advancement
verbatim_excerpts.text: Look for what is good or stimulating in the paper, and what knowledge advancement it has made.

verbatim_excerpts.text: does not exceed the state-of-the-art accuracy on an existing benchmark dataset is not grounds for rejection by itself
weigh both the novelty and potential impact of the work alongside the reported performance

verbatim_excerpts.source_locator: Reviewing In a Nutshell > minor flaws
verbatim_excerpts.text: Minor flaws that can be easily corrected should not be a reason to reject a paper.
